about: 10CL016 LE output comb/reg selects (offline; xdev design oreg:S:V). Each LE drives two local outputs: the direct local line (reaches the LUT inputs in li_direct.json) and the second path. Each has a select bit in the LE's own LUT plane, 1 = combinational, 0 = registered: direct line at frame +9, second path at frame +8 (frame relative to the LE's LUT frame 0). Evidence: swapping which output carries comb/reg (V=0 vs 1) flips exactly these 2 bits, identical at X10Y10 and X22Y8 for all 13 slots measured; with both outputs registered (V=2) both bits are 0 at all 13 slots. (A first reading, +8 = direct line with 1 = registered, fitted V=0/1 but was falsified by V=2.) Value per source slot: [byte offset of the +8 bit, byte offset of the +9 bit] relative to the LE's low LUT byte (no odd-LE flip). Not tested on silicon. Slots 20 and 28 added from builds with dsts 2/6/10 (slot 24 differed between the 2 LABs: byte 0 vs 1 for the +8 bit). Blind check at X6Y12 and X28Y5: 24/26 builds differ in exactly the 2 predicted bits. The 2 blind misses (X6Y12 slots 6, 8) and slot 24 all had the +9 (direct line) bit where predicted, with the +8 bit one byte over (0 <-> 1): the +8 select sits at byte 0 or 1 depending on which second-path line Quartus used, consistent with the second path's 2-bit line select. Direct-line (+9) bit: 26/26 blind.
